text: Oh, hello.\nHow are you doing?\nDid you get any information about holy gems?
...Oh, really.\nApparently, it's not going to be easy...
Hmm, you seem to be having a hard time...\n...Us? We're gettin' rid of the monsters\naround here. We were not asked to do it though.
You know, they do harm to Elves around here.\nAnd they're tough.
But what brought you here?\n...Oh, dear! He's the son of a well-known noble\nElf family. Balft!
Yea. We can't pretend not to hear that.\nWe'll give you a hand, adventurer!
Let's split up and look for him.
Please be careful on your way...
